output: Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that enables systems to learn and improve from experience without being explicitly programmed.
Neural networks are computing systems inspired by the human brain. They consist of interconnected layers of nodes that process information by transforming inputs through weighted connections.

A transformer is a deep learning architecture that uses self-attention mechanisms to process sequences. It allows the model to weigh the importance of different parts of the input simultaneously, making it highly effective for language tasks.
Overfitting happens when a model learns the training data too well, including its noise and outliers. The result is high accuracy on training data but poor performance on new, unseen data.

Transfer learning is when a model trained on one task is repurposed as the starting point for a model on a second task. It leverages learned features from the first task to improve performance on the new task with less data.
